rationale: Price is at 98.8% of today's range, within 0.15% of the session high, after a large gap-up and a sustained intraday rally from $8.81 to $10.02 — the easy move has already occurred. There is no news catalyst to explain the continued momentum, volume is tapering on the last few 1-minute candles (477, 958 shares), and entering long at the top of a wide range with no fresh catalyst carries poor risk/reward. A short against the high is tempting but the stock is showing persistent bid strength with a tight spread and relative volume still elevated, making a fade equally risky without a clear reversal signal.
